WITH race_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    AVG(ds.points) as avg_points,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) as driver_count
  FROM driverStandings ds
  INNER JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(driver_count) as avg_count
  FROM race_stats
),
filtered_races AS (
  SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.driver_count, oac.avg_count
  FROM race_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count oac
  WHERE rs.driver_count > oac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_points),
  AVG(driver_count),
  AVG(driver_count - avg_count)
FROM filtered_races

assumptions.assumption: The count of distinct drivers includes all drivers with driverStandings records for a race, even those with NULL points. The 'ignoring missing values' directive applies only to the average points calculation, not to the driver count.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude driverStandings rows where points is NULL before computing counts and averages, treating missing standings values as drivers without standings for that race.
